Maya (Docs): Quick sync 1 0: I'm prepping a docs PR to update console observability snippets: moving dashboard links to the v2 alias pattern, renaming `trace_ctx` -> `trace_context`, and fixing a couple of cost/latency labels that show Mbps instead of ms.
Ravi (Eng): Sounds good. Do you have the list of files?
Maya (Docs): Yep: docs/observability/dashboards/*.md, docs/tracing/hooks.md, console/snippets/latency-cost.md, sdk-examples/python/tracing.py, and the quickstart embed examples.
Ellen (DevEx): Heads-up: the SDK snippet generator sometimes inlines old helper names; if you regenerate snippets we should run a diff-only PR first.
Maya (Docs): Plan is: 1) sed rename for trace_ctx -> trace_context, 2) manual spot-check for sampling key change (`span.sample_rate` -> `span.sampling.probability`), 3) rewrite dashboard links to /dashboards/v2/aliases/<old-id>, 4) run snippet regen, 5) CI + linkcheck.
Jon (SRE): For the dashboard links, prefer aliases rather than hardcoding /v1 paths. We have redirects for aliases until Q4. Also check the dashboard JSON example where we set `refresh_interval: 30` 1 that's seconds but we document in minutes in one place.
Maya (Docs): Good catch. I'll normalize to seconds across examples.
Ravi (Eng): I made a small helper script to find likely manual touchpoints (pattern matches for sampling, refresh_interval, and trace_ctx). I can attach it to the PR for reviewers.
Maya (Docs): Please do. QA-Bot: Reminder: PRs with more than 10 files touched will trigger staged CI; consider splitting rename-only into its own PR.
Maya (Docs): I'll do a rename-only PR first then follow-up with manual fixes.
Marta (Support): FYI some customers opened tickets about broken dashboard links last month; if we're switching to aliases, can we add a short note in the migration guide and a redirect announcement?
Ellen (DevEx): Add a note to docs/migration/observability.md and a short blurb for the status page.
Maya (Docs): Will add both. Also found two internal links in the latency-cost example that pointed to a private gist; replacing with in-repo sample JSON.
Ravi (Eng): After the sed, run `git grep -n "trace_ctx"` and attach output in the PR description so reviewers can verify changes.
Maya (Docs): Done. I'm drafting the commit message: "docs(obsv): migrate trace helper -> trace_context; use dashboard v2 aliases; fix latency units"
Jon (SRE): One manual check - the tracing hook example for Node sets `span.tags['env']` but our symbology prefers `attributes.env` now. Please align that too.
Maya (Docs): Noted. That's a manual fix in hooks.md.
QA-Bot: After CI passes, I'll run snippet render tests and post results.
Maya (Docs): Targeting PR in ~40 minutes. I'll tag @ravi for engineering review and @ellen for snippet regen flow.
Ellen (DevEx): If snippet regen is needed, let me know and I'll queue the snippet builder.
Marta (Support): Please cc support on the migration note so we can proactively notify affected customers.
Maya (Docs): Will do. PR link (when created) will be posted here. Thanks all. :sparkles:
